RESULT NOTIFICATION PROCLAMATION
    NOTIFICATION NO. 9497-CE/PA
INTRODUCTION
The Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education Gujranwala was established in 1983 Under the Punjab Boards of Intermediate & Secondary Education Act 1976. It consists of six districts i.e. 
Gujranwala, Gujrat, Hafizabad, Mandi Baha-ud-Din, Narowal and Sialkot.
The Govt. of the Punjab Education Department has restored the part wise Examination system at SSC level vide notification No. SO (Boards) 12-54/2001 dated 8, August 2007. Since then the 
examination of SSC Part-I is being conducted separately. The Secondary School (9th Class) Examination Annual,2025 was commenced from 25-03-2025 to 18-04-2025.
278724 candidates applied for the Examination among whom 271463 candidates were appeared. The result is being declared on 20-08-2025.
PROCLAMATION
i.
This Result Gazette is issued as a notice only. Errors and Omissions are excepted.
ii.    The result of all candidates whether successful or otherwise is being published for convenience of all concerned.
iii.   The numerical figures given in the result column show the marks obtained by the candidates whereas abbreviations show the subjects in which the candidates obtained less than pass marks.
CANCELLED ROLL NUMBERS
The Admissions of the candidates sent provisionally by the institutions but finally withdrawn or of those candidates, who were found ineligible for any other reason, have also been cancelled.
CHANCE TO REAPPEAR FOR PART - I 
Those candidates who appeared in the Secondary School (9th Class) Annual Examination 2025 and got less than pass marks in the subject/s may appear with Secondary School Part-II (10th Class) 
Annual Examination,2026.
RESULT LATER CASES
Successful efforts have been made to reduce the number of result later cases which is negligible percentage. However, the results of those candidates are still pending who inspite of repeated 
reminders have failed to remove discrepancies such as:-
Non-adjustment of fee accounts
Non-determination of their eligibility.
Any other discrepancy already intimated to them.
All such candidates are advised in their own interest to deposit arrears of fee, if any and to comply with other requirements already intimated without further delay; otherwise the office 
would not be able to release their result intimations.

RESULT INTIMATION
Result cards to all private candidates have been dispatched as per their given addresses on admission forms. 
Regular candidates will receive their result cards from their concerned institutions.
ENQUIRIES
All Enquiries regarding result of regular candidates should contact to the Heads of their respective institutions instead of Controller of Examinations.
All Enquiries regarding result of private candidates of SSC (9th Class) Examination Annual,2025 should contact to the Assistant Controller of Examinations (9th Class) or call on phone No. 055 3894499.
The Enquiries regarding adjustment of dues such as examination fee etc. should contact to the Assistant/Deputy Secretary (Finance) or call on Phone No. 055-9200751-755 Ext: 125,129 B.I.S.E,
Gujranwala.

In view of strict measures adopted to curb the tendency of unfair means in the examination, remarkable improvement has been noted. Despite of our vast and comprehensive inspections only 7 cases in all 
could be detected with alleged use of unfair means in the examination halls and complaint received. The numbers of unfair means cases detected this year and so far decided are mentioned here under. A 
judicious procedure has been observed to decide all these cases. Before deciding the cases of alleged use of unfair means, maximum efforts have been made to provide fair opportunity of defence to all the 
candidates involved in such cases. A liberal offer has been made to the candidates to avail the chance of personal interview with Discipline committee and it has been ensured that personal hearing is granted 
to every such candidate who has shown his willingness for this purpose. All the undecided cases are pending for want of written reply from the candidates in response to charge sheet issued to them by the 
office. These candidates have been reminded more than once to submit their statements to the office to proceed further in the cases. All of them are hereby advised to submit their written defence to avoid 
ex-party decision.
